findings.description: Eighteen simulated accounts can still authenticate with phishable MFA methods.
findings.remediation: Require passkeys and remove phishable MFA methods for affected accounts.

findings.description: Seven simulated accounts retain a fallback that can bypass passkey enforcement.
findings.remediation: Disable weak fallback methods after confirming passkey recovery coverage.

findings.description: Four simulated applications may initiate device-code authentication without restriction.
findings.remediation: Allow device-code authentication only for approved applications and registered devices.
